name: Torque Auto Advisor
description: Next.js 16 (React 19) web application for Torque Auto Advisor with responsive mobile action bar, touch carousels, and complete vehicle services catalog.
features: Homepage with Hero Slider, About, Services Carousel, Why Choose Us, Funfacts, FAQ, Testimonials, News/Blogs
About Us page with experience timeline, statistics, and company values
Our Services catalog displaying all 9 RTO & vehicle services
Dynamic Service Detail pages with custom descriptions and key points
Photo Gallery with category tabs and full-screen lightbox preview
Contact Us page with interactive inquiry form linked to WhatsApp & phone
Mobile Bottom Action Bar for instant Call, WhatsApp, Services, and Google Maps Directions
